_about: Fictional SOC 2 Type 2 scope and exceptions for Northwind Analytics Ltd., for testing and the demo. Not a real company or report.

exceptions.text: For 2 of 25 sampled terminated employees, logical access was removed more than 24 hours after the termination date.
Monthly authenticated vulnerability scans were not evidenced for two of the twelve months in the period.
For 3 of 40 sampled changes, approval was recorded after deployment to production.
